review:
St Patrick's Day on the Bonanza engine: fruit and lucky clovers cascading down, paying anywhere on screen. Scatters can land on every reel and pay in any position.

In the bonus, scatters behave differently, and the multiplier symbol is where the big wins come from, as with the rest of the family. Chance x2 makes four scatters more likely. High volatility, a 15,000x max and 95.97% RTP. Be ready for long gaps between free spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
